agents.name: documenter
agents.description: Reviews all project documentation (every Markdown file, including agent documentation) and brings it up to date with the current state of the code. Use proactively after changes that affect user-facing behaviour, commands, structure, dependencies, conventions, or agent definitions, and whenever the user asks to update or review the documentation. It edits documentation and canonical agent prompts only; it never changes application code.

agents.name: obs-action-author
agents.description: Scaffolds and wires new OBS or system actions for LinuxStreamDeck following the declarative Action pattern, with correct thread-safe OBS access. Use when the user wants to add an action, extend the OBS catalogue, or expose more of the obs-websocket API on a key.

agents.name: render-qa
agents.description: Verifies LinuxStreamDeck key rendering offscreen without launching the GUI. Use after changes to device/renderer.py, core/icons.py, icon assets, or active-state logic, or whenever the user asks to verify how keys look.

agents.name: reviewer
agents.description: Reviews code changes for LinuxStreamDeck's concurrency, rendering, config-isolation, single-instance, EventBus, and English-only invariants. Use proactively after changes to obs/, device/, core/icons.py, core/controller.py, core/events.py, or ui/, and whenever the user asks to review a diff or check for regressions. It reports findings only and never edits code.
